falsifiable_hypothesis: The global positive-signal switch promotes the bounded raw B gain vector whenever aggregate signal is present, but targetwise raw gains still contain jackknife noise. The already-frozen PRIOR=0.125 supplies a conservative unit of shrinkage. Moving exactly 2*PRIOR=0.25 of the way from the active raw gain vector toward a reliability-weighted common gain is a single fixed protocol step that can reduce variance without collapsing the target structure or changing the fallback branch.
gain_rule: Reproduce shared_prior_margin_dual_gain gain fitting exactly through the current final B gain g_raw/fallback, prior_gain g0, target gain reliability r_g, and the global use_raw switch. If use_raw is false, preserve the existing fallback gain unchanged. If use_raw is true, define delta_j=g_raw,j-g0,j and mu_g=sum_j r_g,j*delta_j/sum_j r_g,j, with mu_g=0 only when all r_g are zero. Define common gain g_common,j=clip(g0,j+mu_g,[0.875,3]). Deploy gB_j=(1-2*PRIOR)*g_raw,j+(2*PRIOR)*g_common,j, with PRIOR=0.125, so the shrink strength is exactly 0.25. No per-target strength or outer-held routing is used.
theta_rule: After constructing deployed gB, reproduce hierarchical_impact_common_bias_theta exactly using the deployed gain: compute theta bias reliability r_theta, orientation A thetaA=theta_full+(1+r_theta)*bias, B common weights w_j=gB_j^2*r_theta,j, common theta bias mu_B=sum w*bias/sum w, and thetaB=theta_full+bias+mu_B+r_theta*(bias-mu_B). Use qA=qA_loo_bagged+0.5*gA*thetaA and qB=qB_interpolated_jackknife-0.5*gB*thetaB.
strength_rationale: The shrink strength is exactly two copies of the already-frozen PRIOR constant, 2*0.125=0.25. This family was selected after repeated development diagnostics and is not independent validation.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
